description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified asset group
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHostGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host to which the asset group belongs.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组所在的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the asset group belongs.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group that you want to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

HostGroup.description_en: The details of the asset group
HostGroup.description_zh: 查询到的资产组详细信息

Comment.description_en: The description of the asset group

HostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the asset group

HostGroupName.description_en: The name of the asset group
